  • Classes
    Class
    Description
    AleaCommand
    Implements the alea test command for forcing a transporter room destination.
    BackCommand
    Implements the back command, moving the player to the previous room when possible.
    BattleCommand
    Starts a trainer battle, or lists available trainers when no trainer name is provided.
    CashinCommand
    Implements the cashin command, converting selected quest items into money.
    Command
    Base type for all executable player commands.
    CommandWords
    Maintains the fixed vocabulary of primary commands understood by the game.
    DropCommand
    Implements the drop command, moving an item from the inventory to the current room.
    GoCommand
    Implements the go command for room navigation and transporter movement.
    HelpCommand
    Implements the help command, printing the game goal and command list.
    InventoryCommand
    Implements the inventory command, printing the player's current items.
    LoadCommand
    Implements the load command, restoring game state from a save file.
    LookCommand
    Implements the look command, reprinting the current room description.
    NameCommand
    Implements the name command, changing the player's display name.
    Parser
    Converts raw user input into executable command objects.
    QuitCommand
    Implements the quit command, ending the game when the syntax is valid.
    SaveCommand
    Implements the save command, writing the current game state to a save file.
    TakeCommand
    Implements the take command, buying or collecting an item from the current room.
    TestCommand
    Implements the test command, replaying commands from a text resource.
